text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate detected in prod-us-east-1 (5xx + timeouts). p95 -> 1.8s, p99 -> 5.2s, 5xx rate 7.8% over the last 3m. Trigger threshold: p99 > 3.5s or 5xx > 5%. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/alerts/4451236789

Amber (oncall): I'm on it. Paging SRE + runtime. Do we know which deploy was the most recent?

Sanjay: recent deploys: release/2026-03-15-22:10 (canary -> prod) finished at 22:12 UTC. Spike started ~22:13 UTC. Correlates with that deploy. Running quick query for 504 vs 500 vs timeouts now.

Elena: seeing a lot of gateway 504s from nginx-ingress at the same timeframe. Sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T22:13:27Z gateway nginx ingress: upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream, client=10.2.1.45, request="POST /v1/generate"
```

Mike: which model variant is that traffic hitting? Could be a new KV cache ordering change in runtime.

Sanjay: traffic map -> majority hitting model redwood-7b-v3 (new quant path) on cluster gpu-pool-7. p99 tail distributions show heavy elongation on sequences >512 tokens.

Priya: customer impact check: Topline: ~6% of requests in US region failing with 5xx during spike. Affected customers include two enterprise tenants (acct-A, acct-C) with higher QPS. Error budget burn alarm firing.

Amber (oncall): ok tradeoffs: do we try live mitigation (scale up / route to fallback model / reduce concurrency) OR rollback release? Rollback will be fastest to remove regression if deploy is culprit. Thoughts?

Elena: quick mitigation: reduce max_concurrency on gpu-pool-7 from 8 -> 4, and enable fallback routing to redwood-7b-v2 (older quant) for 10% of traffic. But scaling won't help if kernel path is stalling on long sequences. Risk: mitigation might reduce capacity and increase queuing.

Mike: I vote rollback, given timing correlation and enterprise impact. We have previous stable hash available. Rolling back to release/2026-03-15-21:58 should revert the quant/kernel change.

Amber (oncall): authorize rollback then. Please run rollback and watch. @deploy-bot can you run: `/deploy rollback release/2026-03-15-22:10 --reason=timeout-regression`

deploy-bot: Received command from Amber (oncall). Initiating rollback to release/2026-03-15-21:58. Step 1: disable new deploy's routing. Step 2: rollback runtime images on gpu-pool-7. Estimated time ~2m. Will post updates.

incident-bot: NOTE: Paging reminder: escalate to pagerduty if customer impact >5% for >10m. Current impact window 3m.

Sanjay: rolling logs show graceful drain of workers, healthcheck passing on old version coming back up. Rolling rollback tasks to 3/6 nodes done.

Priya: I'm posting an internal customer alert to ACCT-A and ACCT-C with initial heads-up and ETA for remediation: "We're investigating elevated timeouts and have initiated a rollback. Expect degraded behavior to improve within ~10 minutes. Will follow up."

Elena: after rollback halfway, we're seeing p99 drop to 2.0s and 5xx to ~2.1% on the canary slice. Good sign.

Amber (oncall): continue rollback to completion and watch for reappearance. Also capture traces for 22:10-22:16 window. Sam (tracing) please grab spans for model redwood-7b-v3.

Mike: I've dumped a few worker stacks and see stuck kernels in attention CUDA calls for long seqs. Suspect kernel selection mismatch after quant change. Will add notes to incident.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 22:18:50 UTC. All nodes on gpu-pool-7 back to release/2026-03-15-21:58.

incident-bot: Metrics update: p95 -> 0.46s, p99 -> 0.9s, 5xx -> 0.9% (us-east-1) in last 2m post-rollback.

Priya: Customer update: sent follow-up: "Rollback complete; normal service should resume. Please open a case if you see continued errors."

Amber (oncall): Great. Assigning follow-up actions: - Mike to capture kernel traces and produce a short repro. - Sanjay + Elena to validate canary config for future deploys (add seq-length stress test). - Priya to coordinate customer comms and CC support leads. - Carol (oncall-next) will take a warm handoff for monitoring the next 2 hours.

Mike: I filed a bug: RDW-INC-1924 with kernel stack dumps and initial hypothesis (kernel/quant change causing tail stalls).

Sanjay: I'll run a synthetic job hitting long sequences on a staging variant of the quant path. If repro, we'll pin the quant profile until fix.

Carol (oncall-next): taking handoff. Thanks team — I'll keep an eye on alerts and queue up a postmortem doc with timeline. Any context to add?

Amber (oncall): TL;DR: deploy/22:10 introduced a quant/kernel path change -> p99 spike & 5xxs -> rollback at 22:18 -> metrics returned to normal. Impacted enterprise tenants notified. Postmortem to follow.

incident-bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" at 22:19:10 UTC. Creating incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4451236789.

Priya: I'll kick off outreach to top affected customers tomorrow morning PST and schedule follow-up with account teams.

Carol (oncall-next): I'll own the postmortem draft and link the traces/bug. Passing to triage rotation. Signing off from active pager but will stay reachable if it flares. :white_check_mark:

Amber (oncall): Thanks everyone. Good quick coordination.
